schemaStability: Stable column names and meanings. Comparison columns are added for each past election the page compares against (ballots_<year>_same_point and so on), so the set of columns can grow when a year is added; existing ones keep their meaning. A blank count in mail_rejected, mail_cancelled_or_spoiled or mail_other means 1 to 9 (withheld), not zero.
title: Georgia early voting: county totals
description: One row per Georgia county: accepted early and mail ballots so far, the mail pipeline, and comparisons with past elections at the same point before election day.

metadata.description: What this file describes: the election, the as-of date, the comparison points, sources and caveats.

active_voters.description: Registered voters with active status (Secretary of State active/inactive table). The denominator of turnout_pct_of_active.

ballots.description: Accepted ballots so far: early in person plus accepted mail and electronic ballots, one per voter.

turnout_pct_of_active.description: ballots as a percentage of active_voters.

citizen_adults_est.description: ESTIMATED citizen adults: residents 18 and over minus non-citizen residents of every age, from the Census Bureau's American Community Survey (newest 5-year vintage), compiled by Georgia Civic Data (CC BY 4.0). Runs slightly low because the source table has no age split.

ballots_pct_of_citizen_adults_est.description: ballots as a percentage of citizen_adults_est.

adults_25plus_bachelors_pct.description: Percent of adults 25 and over with a bachelor's degree or higher (ACS, via Georgia Civic Data).

mail_outstanding.description: Mail and electronic ballots issued but not yet returned.

mail_rejected.description: Mail ballots rejected after return. Blank = 1 to 9 (withheld).

mail_cancelled_or_spoiled.description: Mail ballots cancelled or spoiled. Blank = 1 to 9 (withheld).

mail_other.description: Mail records with no ballot yet (for example an application awaiting cure). Blank = 1 to 9 (withheld).

ballots_2022_same_point.description: Ballots accepted in 2022 at the comparison point for 2022 (see metadata.comparisons for how many days before election day).

ballots_2026_at_2022_point.description: This year's ballots at that same point, so the two can be compared directly.

early_share_2022_pct.description: Percent of 2022's final votes in the county's top contest cast early or by mail (certified results).

carried_2022.description: Party whose candidate won more than half of the county's 2022 top-of-ticket votes: R, D, O (another party), or blank if no one cleared half.

carried_2022_pct.description: That candidate's share of all 2022 top-of-ticket votes in the county.

repeat_2022_pct.description: Percent of this year's ballots cast by someone who also voted early or by mail in 2022 (county aggregate of a voter-id match; no voter-level data is published).

ballots_2024_same_point.description: Ballots accepted in 2024 at the comparison point for 2024 (see metadata.comparisons for how many days before election day).

ballots_2026_at_2024_point.description: This year's ballots at that same point, so the two can be compared directly.

early_share_2024_pct.description: Percent of 2024's final votes in the county's top contest cast early or by mail (certified results).

carried_2024.description: Party whose candidate won more than half of the county's 2024 top-of-ticket votes: R, D, O (another party), or blank if no one cleared half.

carried_2024_pct.description: That candidate's share of all 2024 top-of-ticket votes in the county.

repeat_2024_pct.description: Percent of this year's ballots cast by someone who also voted early or by mail in 2024 (county aggregate of a voter-id match; no voter-level data is published).

as_of.description: Date the data runs through (constant, so a detached file still says what it describes).
